additionalDocuments.label: SAMANA Mykonos Signature · original official brochure and home drawings

review.imagery: Twenty own-project renders cover the complete building, retail frontage, leisure deck, facade, lobby and home interiors. Forty main native resources, four additional page-14/page-31 resources and six primary gallery images were visually reviewed. Generic windmill/city/people composites, old portfolio pages, unpainted alternative layers and repeated gallery copies are excluded. The current primary building-and-pool view supplies the card and hero. The selection remains separate from original Mykonos.
review.floorPlans: Eighteen complete source sheets include four official brochure home drawings, four home drawings in the broker-hosted branded pack, and ground/mezzanine/first-to-eighth-floor building overviews. The 2 BR configurations differ between the brochure and plan pack. Options retain their source identity. Ground and mezzanine sheets retain retail scope. No numerical unit area or approved numbered-unit matching is stated. The sources include a non-pool studio despite the current FAQ’s pool-focused summary. Confirm the approved release, unit configuration, area definition and pool provision with SAMANA. All four complete official pages 47–50 and fourteen mirror drawing pages 2–15 were visually reviewed. Each residential floor 1–8 remains individually selectable. The brochure and mirror 2 BR layouts visibly differ and are retained separately. No unit area is inferred from the factsheet’s building totals or balcony-pool dimensions. Original physical page links and branding remain intact.
review.location: Complete official maps 38–39 and the corresponding detailed broker factsheet maps were visually reviewed. The official neighbourhood map supplies the displayed artwork. Its Signature-source and regional scope are explicit. Sixteen current-primary ranges are transcribed, with conflicting brochure values and its ambiguous airport line qualified. The name-only primary map query is recorded with HTML hash. No coordinate or live route is inferred.
review.provenance: Official primary HTML, brochure PDF, native image origins and Mitchell’s branded plan pack retain receipts and hashes. The broker document remains labeled as a mirror. Complete source pages preserve all branding and physical source-page links. Primary and mirrored floor-plan variants retain separate source identities. Completed text research and protected identity remain intact.

unavailable: Drawing-specific numerical unit areas, approved unit/release mapping between differing home variants, precise visitor entrance coordinates, final fitout/views, dated construction photographs and live journey times require confirmation.
